# Croom Baptisms — Page 125 (Dec 1880–Jun 1881)

**Image:** `page_125_baptism_dec1880_jun1881.jpg`
**Date range (per gon.pages_metadata):** Dec 1880 to Jun 1881 (**final baptism page of NLI Croom microfilm 02427/07**)
**Officiant on most entries:** Joannes Quinlan (P.P.); one entry signed Joannes Brennan; one Joannes Quinlan o.r.

## Patrick Gleeson + Margaret Moloney baptisms

**None found on this page.**

## Patrick Gleeson appears as SPONSOR — high-leverage finding ⭐

> **17 Feb 1881:** *Joannes filius Jacobi Moloney et Honoraea David. Spons: Patritii Gleeson et Joannae [?]. Joannes Quinlan*

**Patritii Gleeson (Patrick Gleeson) appears as godfather** to a Moloney child on 17 February 1881. Co-godmother Joannae [?] (Johanna — possibly Johanna Moloney, since Moloney-Moloney pairing on the godfather side is the only clear context).

### Is this our Patrick?

**Strongly probable** for these reasons:
1. **Moloney family on parent side.** Jacobi Moloney + Honoraea David — godfather pulled from kin network; our Patrick is married to Margaret Moloney
2. **Croom register prior context.** Of the documented Patrick Gleesons in Croom register so far, only our Patrick has multiple appearances and Moloney-family ties (no other Patrick Gleeson surfaces in Croom register entries we've reviewed)
3. **Timing.** Falls within our active Patrick window (alive 1869 last Petty Sessions, dead by 1901 Census)
4. **Sponsor pattern.** Patrick had been sparsely-attested as a sponsor in earlier pages but this Moloney-side baptism is exactly the kind of relationship our Patrick would sponsor

**Caveat:** The entry just says "Patritii Gleeson" without townland or occupation. Other Gleeson Patricks could theoretically exist in the parish, though none has surfaced in the 80+ pages of register sweep so far. **Treat as a probable proof-of-life for our Patrick at 17 Feb 1881.**

### Implication

If this attribution holds, Patrick's death window tightens to **17 Feb 1881 → 31 Mar 1901** (~20 years).

## Sweep result

✅ No baptism of Patrick Gleeson + Margaret Moloney's child on this page.
⭐ Patrick alive **17 Feb 1881** (probable; awaits corroboration).

## Boundary note

**Page 125 is the final baptism page on NLI Croom microfilm 02427/07** (baptisms run pages 4–125, covering Oct 1844 – Jun 1881). For baptisms after Jun 1881 — including any later-born Gleeson child — the next source is **civil birth registration** (irishgenealogy.ie, free post-1864). NLI does not host a successor Croom baptism register for this period.
